title: "Development"

## Tests

The tests use Pest and run under PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5. They call functions through
`pipe()`, so they parse on every version. `tests/Pipe/` holds the tests written
with `|>`; `bin/test` leaves them out before PHP 8.5.

```bash
composer install
bin/test                 # loads .ext/libphit.dylib when present
NO_EXT=1 bin/test        # pure-PHP descriptive statistics
PHP=/path/to/php83 bin/test
```

The method chain's `@method` list in `src/Chain.php` is generated. After
adding or changing a table function, run `bin/chain-docblock`; a test fails while the
list is out of date.

Most tests compare phplyr with R. The scripts in `tests/r/` run the same
pipelines with dplyr and tidyr and write JSON fixtures to `tests/Fixtures/`:

```bash
Rscript tests/r/reference.R   # single-table functions, windows, across, tidyselect
Rscript tests/r/expr.R        # expressions
Rscript tests/r/joins.R       # joins and rowwise
Rscript tests/r/join_by.R     # join_by() conditions
Rscript tests/r/tidyr.R       # tidyr functions
Rscript tests/r/rows.R        # set operations, rows_*(), dplyr 1.2 helpers
Rscript tests/r/coverage.R    # functions added after phplyr 0.1.0
Rscript tests/r/models.R      # lm() and glm() coefficients
Rscript tests/r/janitor.R     # janitor functions (needs the janitor package)
```

`composer lint` checks the naming conventions with PHP_CodeSniffer.

## Documentation

The site is a Quarto project in `docs/`. Code examples live in
`docs/examples/*.php`. `bin/docs-examples` runs each one with `docs/data` as the
working directory and writes `docs/examples/_<name>.md` with the code and its
output, which the pages include. Rendering never executes PHP.

An example uses `|>`, and `docs/examples/<name>.chain.php` beside it is the
same example as a method chain. `bin/docs-examples` runs both and fails if
their output differs. The page shows the two in tabs labeled "PHP 8.5+" and
"PHP 8.3–8.4", with the output once. `bin/docs-examples` needs PHP 8.5, and it
loads phit from `.ext/libphit.dylib` for the model examples.

Most examples leave out the `require` line and the imports, and
`bin/docs-examples` adds them before it runs the code. An example that
requires `vendor/autoload.php` itself is a complete script. It runs as
written, so a missing import fails the run, and the page shows the whole file.
The first example and the pages in the Examples section
(`docs/examples/<slug>.qmd`, with their code in `docs/examples/pages/`) are
complete scripts. The Examples pages leave out the opening tag and the
`require` line.

```bash
PHP=/path/to/php85 bin/docs-examples   # refresh example output
PHP=/path/to/php85 bin/render-docs     # examples, quarto render, publish to docs/
```

Commit the rendered HTML. phpstats.org imports it from the commit it pins
and serves it at <https://phplyr.phpstats.org/docs>. GitHub Pages serves
redirects to those pages, which `.github/workflows/pages.yml` builds with
`bin/pages-redirects`.

## Site content

`site/` holds phplyr's content for phplyr.phpstats.org. The phpstats site
reads it at a pinned commit.

| Path | Contents | Made by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `site/site.json` | Manifest: summary, install, example, docs pages, examples, and file lists | `bin/site-manifest` |
| `site/benchmarks/backends.json` | Backend and dplyr timings | `bin/site-benchmarks`, from `docs/benchmarks/` |
| `site/verifications/*.json` | Every test that checks phplyr against R, with its assertion count and largest floating-point error | `bin/site-verifications` |

`bin/site-verifications` runs the test suite with `PHPLYR_VERIFY_LOG` set.
Each test that reads an R fixture through `rReference()` then logs its
assertions and the differences recorded by `expectClose()`. The script writes
nothing unless every test passes. Set `POLARS_PHP` to a PHP command that loads
php_polars to add the PolarsTable parity file.

To refresh the benchmarks, run `bench/backends.php --csv-dir=bench/data`,
then `Rscript bench/backends.R`, then `bin/site-benchmarks`. `tests/SiteTest.php`
checks that the files and pages site.json names exist.

## Layout

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `src/functions/verbs.php` | Single-table functions |
| `src/functions/chain.php`, `src/Chain.php` | `phplyr()` method chains and `pipe()` |
| `src/functions/vectors.php` | Summary, window, and conditional helpers |
| `src/functions/select.php` | tidyselect helpers and `across()` |
| `src/functions/joins.php`, `rows.php` | Joins, set operations, and `rows_*()` |
| `src/functions/groups.php` | Group utilities, binding, and model adapters |
| `src/functions/tidyr.php` | tidyr functions |
| `src/Vec.php` | The per-group vector expression behind the helpers |
| `src/Ops.php` | Group-vector primitives over the Table contract |
